objective: Evaluate causal, long-only BTC/USD candidates on the latest 30 complete days without selecting on a single 24-hour boundary.

market.selectionData: No summary, per-window return, or candidate ranking was read before this registration.

execution.windowEnd: All positions are marked flat at the 24-hour boundary using that boundary's observable open; no later candle data is read.

qualificationOverlay.schedule: Final ten minutes of each 24-hour window; sequential one-minute round trips in fixed even-minute slots.
qualificationOverlay.accounting: A dedicated 1% sleeve is held out at window start. Overlay profit/loss and fees are reported separately and never decide candidate signals.

windows.selection: Rank only aggregate development metrics across all four offsets. Freeze one candidate ID before opening holdout results.

holdoutGate: more positive than negative windows after all fees and overlay trades
positive expectancy and profit factor greater than one
worst-window loss and max drawdown better than v1 or bounded by the predeclared daily loss cap
no offset has a negative mean return and no single window contributes more than 50% of total P&L
materially beats v1 positive-window ratio by at least 5 percentage points and beats cash

expansionPolicy.rule: If no candidate passes, add only a new distinct family in a separately timestamped preregistration before reviewing its development summary. Stop honestly after generation four.
